intuition: The best circular subarray is either an ordinary maximum segment or the total minus a minimum segment.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate every circular start and length and sum its elements.

optimal.approach: Track Kadane's maximum subarray, minimum subarray, and total sum in one pass.

edge_cases: A single element is its own maximum subarray.
All-negative inputs must use the ordinary maximum, not an empty wraparound.
A wrapped optimum may join a prefix and suffix.
